reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Vlad is the CEO and co-founder of Robinhood.
reader_summary.overview: Vlad is the CEO and co-founder of Robinhood. It was such a treat to sit down with him and discuss the behind-the-scenes of a revolutionary business we all know well. He details Robinhood’s journey to zero-cost trading and what it means to build a consumer-centric financial product.

key_points.text: Vlad believes in finding the harmonies across mathematics and art and applies this lens to everything he builds.
We discuss Robinhood’s new credit card and more products on the horizon, the company’s toughest moments, including the Gamestop episode.
Please enjoy this conversation with Vlad Tenev.
